```
build-ffi: don't strip host proc-macros and build scripts

On macOS 27.0.1, build-ffi.sh fails in a fresh target directory with
"can't find crate for thiserror_impl". dyld refuses to load every host
proc-macro dylib with "mis-aligned LINKEDIT string pool".

The script exports MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0, and the variable also
reaches host proc-macros and build scripts. At a 14.0 floor the linker
writes chained fixups. rustc then strips release dylibs with its bundled
rust-objcopy, which leaves the string table only 4-byte aligned, and
macOS 27.0.1 rejects that. The same dylib loads when it is unstripped or
stripped with /usr/bin/strip. SDKROOT has no effect.

Set CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=false so build-override
artifacts are left unstripped. rustc reads the deployment target only
from the environment, so RUSTFLAGS or a link argument can't limit it to
the two cross targets, and lowering it for host builds isn't possible
without also changing it for the shipped library.

The shipped static library is unchanged, and every object in it still
targets macOS 14.0 on both architectures.
```
